component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.ui.operations.contrib
component.documentation: AgenticUi.RunAction: runs one action of a business app's actions.json on the input record, as the app registry serves it, after checking the allow-list again and the user's permission on the record. Its parameters are the app's id, the action's id, and what the user entered in the action's form; never the operation.
